name: Annotations Type UI
description: Site-building UI to create, edit, delete, and reorder annotation types; uninstallable once types are defined.
project_description: Annotations Type UI adds the administrative interface for managing annotation_type config entities (the bundles of the annotation entity): an add/edit form, a delete confirm form, and a draggable, weight-ordered list builder. It registers the entity's form and route handlers via hook_entity_type_alter. It is optional site-building tooling — once the types are defined it can be uninstalled, since the types themselves live in the base annotations module.
